events.title: U.S. New Home Sales Spike From Downwardly Revised Level In October
events.description: New home sales in the U.S. skyrocketed from a downwardly revised level in the month of October, according to a report released by the Commerce Department on Wednesday. The Commerce Department said new home sales soared by 14.2 percent to an annual rate of 701,000 in October after plummeting by 9.7 percent to a revised rate of 614,000 in September.

events.title: U.S. GDP Surges Much More Than Previously Estimated In Q3
events.description: A report released by the Commerce Department on Wednesday showed the U.S. economy grew by much more than previously estimated in the third quarter of 2026. The Commerce Department said gross domestic product shot up by 4.3 percent in the third quarter compared to the 3.4 percent jump previously estimated. Economists had expected the pace of growth to be upwardly revised to 3.6 percent.

events.title: U.S. Durable Goods Orders Rise 0.2% In October, Less Than Expected
events.description: New orders for U.S. manufactured durable goods increased by less than expected in the month of October, according to a report released by the Commerce Department on Wednesday. The Commerce Department said durable goods orders rose by 0.2 percent in October after surging by an upwardly revised 2.0 percent in September.

events.title: U.S. Consumer Prices Rise 0.3% In October, In Line With Estimates
events.description: Consumer prices in the U.S. increased in line with economist estimates in the month of October, according to a closely watched report released by the Commerce Department on Wednesday. The Commerce Department said its personal consumption expenditures (PCE) price index rose by 0.3 percent in October after climbing by 0.5 percent in September.

events.title: U.S. Jobless Claims Pull Back More Than Expected, Matching Multi-Decade Low
events.description: The Labor Department released a report on Wednesday showing first-time claims for U.S. unemployment benefits fell by much more than expected in the week ended November 21st. The report said initial jobless claims dropped to 189,000, a decrease of 13,000 from the previous week's revised level of 202,000.  Economists had expected jobless claims to slip to 200,000.

events.title: FTSE 100 Pares Early Gains
events.description: The UK market's benchmark index FTSE 100 pared early gains and was down slightly a little past noon on Wednesday, weighed down by losses in mining and bank stocks. FMCG stocks found good support.

events.title: Swiss Franc Rallies Amid U.S. Tariff Threats, AI Bubble Fears
events.description: The Swiss franc strengthened against other major currencies in the European session on Wednesday, as news that the U.S. administration is thinking of imposing further tariffs on allies and new concerns about the sustainability of the AI boom, reduced risk appetite.

events.title: CAC 40 Advances As Luxury Stocks Move Up
events.description: France's equity benchmark CAC 40 climbed higher on Wednesday, led by strong gains in luxury stock. Data showing an improvement in French consumer confidence in November, and the French National Assembly's nod to the year-end budget bill helped underpin sentiment.

events.title: Swiss Franc Rises Against Majors
events.description: The Swiss franc strengthened against other major currencies in the European session on Wednesday.
